# mmadalone Kodi repo (PseudoTV Live madteevee fork)

Add this URL to a Kodi repository addon's `<info>` element:
    https://mmadalone.github.io/PseudoTV_Live/addons.xml

Or install the bundled repository addon:
    https://mmadalone.github.io/PseudoTV_Live/repository.mmadalone.pseudotv/repository.mmadalone.pseudotv-1.0.0.zip

Source: https://github.com/mmadalone/PseudoTV_Live
